headline: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
summary: Lenovo acknowledges reports of Legion Go devices being bricked by a bad BIOS update. Gamers faced nearly $300 repair bills for their handheld PCs. The company is under pressure to offer free fixes for its software-induced hardware failures.

headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: The inventor of the first 3D-printed gun claims a bypass for software blocking firearm creation. This sparks a new battle between regulators and individuals over 'ghost guns'. Governments are trying to stem the tide, while creators seek workarounds.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: Zillow and Redfin have settled an FTC antitrust case regarding their 2025 rental listings partnership. The FTC alleged Zillow paid Redfin to syndicate listings and avoid competition. Redfin reportedly agreed to end advertising contracts and not compete for multifamily listings.

headline: Robotaxis are real now — so is the pushback
summary: Robotaxis are expanding, but face growing resistance over their operational rules. New York's governor withdrew a proposal for driverless taxis after opposition from unions and lawmakers. Commercial driverless service remains illegal in many key areas due to ongoing regulatory battles.

headline: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 Is Now Available to Watch Online
summary: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 is now available for online viewing. Fans can stream the classic storyline. The release includes 4K and Blu-ray options.

headline: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
summary: Newegg offers the most affordable 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 desktop memory. This RAM is ideal for AMD Ryzen-based gaming builds. It provides excellent performance for gaming setups.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: Grab a 1,000W 48V adult electric bike for just $275, including shipping. The bike boasts a 28mph top speed and an impressive 80-mile range. Perfect for faster and easier commutes, especially for students.

headline: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
summary: CD Projekt Red confirmed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's 'Songs of the Past' expansion will feature more Gwent. Card game enthusiasts are celebrating the news. The beloved in-game card game will see an expanded presence.

headline: More than 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England
summary: Over 70,000 new social and affordable homes are planned for construction across England. Significant funding has been allocated to Greater Manchester, West Midlands, and West Yorkshire. London will receive £6 billion for housing development.

headline: Iran says it is ready for what US calls 'greatest financial offensive ever'
summary: Iran states it is prepared for the new US sanctions, dubbed an 'economic D-Day'. Tehran claims it has a strategic plan to counter the US financial offensive. The latest sanctions aim to exert maximum economic pressure on Iran.

headline: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
summary: The Lockerbie bombing trial has been postponed just days before its scheduled start. This marks the third delay for the trial of a Libyan man. New evidence emerged recently, impacting the 37-year-old case.

headline: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
summary: China is experiencing a rapid, quiet revolution in industrial automation beyond humanoid robots. More than two million robots are actively working in Chinese factories. The country is quickly scaling up its manufacturing automation capabilities.
